issue.title: Clarify the maintainer-bot replay fixture greeting
issue.body: The fixture greeting should document its deterministic punctuation behavior.
issue.author: fixture-author
issue.problem: The replay fixture does not explain that its greeting always ends with an exclamation mark.
reproductionSteps: Read packages/maintainer-bot/fixtures/replay-target.ts and observe the undocumented punctuation behavior.
issue.currentBehavior: The function returns deterministic punctuation without an explanatory comment.
issue.expectedBehavior: The fixture source explains the deterministic exclamation-mark behavior without changing runtime output.
acceptanceCriteria: A source comment states that replayGreeting always ends with an exclamation mark.
The replayGreeting return value remains byte-for-byte unchanged.
outOfScope: Do not change production maintainer-bot behavior or any GitHub workflow.
